verdict.rationale: Viam's agent guide says machines can enforce per-resource, per-method restrictions through `user_permissions` in the machine config. That is a genuine least-privilege control aimed at agent use. The fleet API also says it can 'manage permissions and authorization.' However, no evidence shows issuing a dedicated, scoped API key or credential for an agent. missing for 10: documented creation of scoped API keys/credentials for agents, scope granularity at the credential level (org/location/machine roles), credential rotation/revocation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
